| **Check account balances & transactions** (`get_account_info`, `get_transaction_history`) | Monitor cash, holdings, recent trades. | *“Give me my last month’s transaction history.”* |
| **Place or cancel orders** (`place_order`, `cancel_order`) | Execute trades directly through this interface. | *“Buy 10 shares of MSFT at $300 each.”* |
| **Notify on big price swings** (`notify_price_change`) | Set alerts for sudden moves. | *“Alert me if any watched stock changes >5% today.”* |
